description:
FILED + FIXED s1061 (Opus, 2026-09-07) while bisecting #1061's CPAN-board
down-movers.  Commit `8005b834`.

THE BUG.  `$a[0] =~ s///` and `$h{k} =~ tr///` WRITE their target, so
Pl/ExprToCL.pm turns the target on to lvalue_context and the element lowers to
its `-box` head.  The gate asked `_is_elem_arg`, whose set is `a_acc` /
`h_acc` only -- it also answers for the `argbox` path, and the runtime exports
`p-gethash-argbox` / `p-aref-argbox` but no `-deref-argbox`, so it could not
be widened.  Consequently `$r->{k}`, `$r->[i]` and the `$$r{k}` / `${$r}{k}`
spellings of the same access lowered to `p-gethash-deref` /
`p-aref-deref` -- a VALUE -- and the write had nowhere to land.

#960 found and fixed exactly this omission at `pos()`, from the same four-kind
table ("ALL FOUR element kinds ... the DEREF pair was missing").  This is the
`=~` site.  The fix is a SECOND, named predicate `_is_elem_lvalue_target`
beside `_is_elem_arg`, with the comment saying why the two sets differ.

WHY IT WENT FROM QUIET TO FATAL.  Bisected to `bfa170d9` (s461ar, #900 +
#911: "`++` keeps the OBJECT, and the read-only verdict for s///+tr/// moves
to RUN time").  Before it, writing to a non-place was a silent no-op; after
it, it is perl's "Modification of a read-only value attempted".  Core
Math::BigInt writes `$x->{sign} =~ tr/+-/-+/` SIX times (bneg, bsub, bcmp,
…), so from that commit every negation of a Math::BigInt killed the program.

REPRODUCER (perl prints `-|-|aXc|aYc|ABC`; PCL before the fix died on the
first line):

    my $u = { sign => "+" };              $u->{sign}  =~ tr/+-/-+/;
    my $o = bless { sign => "+" }, "Cls"; $o->{sign}  =~ tr/+-/-+/;
    my $e = [ "abc" ];                    $e->[0]     =~ s/b/X/;
    my $f = { k => "abc" };               $$f{k}      =~ s/b/Y/;
    my $d = { in => { k => "abc" } };     $d->{in}{k} =~ tr/a-c/A-C/;
    print "$u->{sign}|$o->{sign}|$e->[0]|$$f{k}|$d->{in}{k}\n";

BOARD COST IT REMOVES.  Scalar-List-Utils max.t 7 ok / 3 not-ok -> 5 / 2 at
`bfa170d9`; min.t, product.t and sum.t share the Math::BigInt tail.  (Those
files' PASS -> PARTIAL move is a DIFFERENT cause, #1507.)

BARS.  Probed vs perl 5.40.3 in eight shapes: the three deref writes now
agree, and so do the five that must NOT move -- a read-only match, an /r
substitution, an index subexpression (`$a[$idx{i}] =~ s///`), a chained
`$d->{in}{k}`, a plain scalar.  `tools/corpus-diff.pl dfa65afa`: emission
IDENTICAL across 111 files, silent drops 5 unchanged (the perl-tests corpus
contains no deref-element write).  `tools/emission-ab.pl --ref dfa65afa
--shapes` over lib/ + the 14-dist board, 251 files: 250 SAME, the one DIFF
being s1061's own #1505 line.  Over the Math::BigInt family: the only content
change is `p-gethash-deref` -> `p-gethash-deref-box` at the six `=~ tr` sites
in BigInt.pm and the matching ones in BigFloat.pm.  Generation `v2-960` ->
`v2-1010` (a MODULE's emission changed, so the module cache must miss); the
three checked-in artifacts regenerated, bodies byte-identical.  Gate 218 files
/ 7573 rows, only the 13 pclxs xs rows failing.  Guards
`Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t` 129 -> 131 (one write row, one INVERSE row), inverse-
verified on a `dfa65afa` extraction where the write row fails and the inverse
row passes.

RESIDUE WORTH A LOOK.  The same four-kind omission is a FAMILY (#960 at
`pos()`, this at `=~`).  A scan of every site that spells `a_acc`/`h_acc`
without the `_ref_acc` pair would say whether a third exists.
subject: FIXED s1061: `$ref->{k} =~ s///` / `=~ tr///` wrote to a VALUE, not a place -- the `=~` write-target gate listed only the NAMED-container element kinds, so the DEREF pair never got lvalue_context; since #911 made that perl's read-only DEATH, core Math::BigInt's `$x->{sign} =~ tr/+-/-+/` killed the program
